findings.summary: redact() never matches JSON-quoted keys ("password":"…"); netlify-cli --json output with a short non-hex secret is printed unredacted into the diagnostic receipt.
Staging Netlify site UUID/hostname hard-coded in three new files (already on main in the preflight script).
deploysMaximum:1 is asserted in self-check output but not enforced; a second deployOnce() overwrites candidateId and orphans the first production-context deploy from cleanup.

findings.outcome_note: identity fallback fails closed (HOSTED_RUNTIME_CONFIGURATION_MISSING); SET ROLE qnow_app on every pooled connection; env readback never reads values; build-artifacts execFile fixed argv; no secrets found in 9.4k lines.
